features.name: Ledger core
features.behavior: The ledger applies a transfer atomically
features.falsifier: A ledger that debits before validating and leaves partial state [INV-LEDGER-1]

features.name: Atomic transfer proof
features.behavior: A rejected transfer leaves every balance unchanged
features.falsifier: A ledger that mutates one balance before rejecting the transfer [INV-LEDGER-1]
